prompt:
Create one landscape PNG raster illustration, native approximately 16:9 (about 1672 x 941). Friendly, warm, clear abstract hand-drawn comic style matching SkillPilot science learning illustrations: soft cream/pale blue background, rounded dark-blue outlines, a few generous colorful shapes and calm composition. Scientifically sound, never photorealistic, never sterile technical CAD. Main idea and critical details must remain clear at 360px total displayed width, and at 680px. No tiny letters, decorative writing, equations, logos, watermark, caption or textual labels. Use large motifs, sufficient white space. This is an author candidate, not quality approval. 
Actual bilingual learning-goal context (do not typeset this): Sozialverhalten von Primaten untersuchen — Die lernende Person kann exogene und endogene Ursachen sozialen Verhaltens bei Primaten erläutern. / Investigate primate social behavior — The learner can explain exogenous and endogenous causes of social behavior in primates.
Scene: Illustrate examining social behavior of primates and distinguishing possible environmental versus internal influences. In a gentle forest scene, two correctly formed chimpanzees without tails groom each other while a third chimpanzee watches near a fruit-bearing tree. Show realistic simple limb counts and plausible grooming hands and body proportions, never human clothing on chimpanzees. At left a friendly adult field observer looks through binoculars from a respectful distance with a notebook correctly oriented for the observer, but its page contains only simple marks, no required writing. Above the main grooming pair are two equally large sparse round thought/context panels: one shows a fruit tree and nearby companions (environmental situation), the other a simple recognizable brain and an unfilled body outline (potential internal influences). These are conceptual hypotheses, not measured hormonal data or proof that one observed behavior establishes its cause. No arrows claiming deterministic genetic causes; no manipulation, cages, threatening animals or clinical experimentation. Large motifs, clean comic illustration, minimal background.
